notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: Conduit runs as a Mac app now, with the phone's settings in their own window.

bullets.text: Settings has the phone's pages: Profile, Personalization, Connection, Chat, Audio and Data Controls.
Your system prompt, memories and quick actions are the ones your Open WebUI account keeps, so they match on every device.
Notes like these appear after each update, and About › What's New shows them again.
